visualCharacteristics: Centred list of questions with chevrons that expand to show answers with a height slide, optionally under a centred section title.
contentPattern: A single-cell row with a heading = section title; each two-cell row = one item, cell 1 the question, cell 2 the answer (any content). Row order is free.
usage: Use for frequently asked questions sections near the end of program, landing and article pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any question/answer list, choosing the layout variant that matches the page rather than building a new accordion.
